story.title: Thirty-one years of Nashville racing, tightened into a registration-ready guide.
paragraphs: The 31st Annual Tom King Classic brings runners to Cornelia Fort Airpark on Saturday, February 28, 2026 for a Half Marathon and 5K Run/Walk. Both races start and finish at the airpark, creating a simple race-morning hub for runners and spectators.

The course promise is specific: out-and-back, certified, fast, and flat routes through Shelby Park and the paved Shelby Bottoms Greenway. Half marathoners can pace the full 13.1 miles, while 5K runners and walkers get the same clear race-morning setup from Cornelia Fort.

Race-day details are straightforward: a 600-participant combined field cap due to parking limits, free race-morning parking with carpooling encouraged, Friday packet pickup at Shelby Park Community Center, race-morning packet pickup at Cornelia Fort, post-race food and awards, shirts guaranteed by February 12, and half marathon finisher medals.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: Both races use a common start and finish line at Cornelia Fort Airpark in Nashville.

faqs.question: What are the race start times?
faqs.answer: The Half Marathon starts at 8:00 AM. The 5K Run/Walk starts at 8:15 AM.

faqs.question: Is registration open?
faqs.answer: RunSignup currently lists online registration as closed and says online registration has ended for both events.

faqs.question: What is the course like?
faqs.answer: Both routes are out-and-back over certified, fast, and flat courses through Shelby Park and the paved Shelby Bottoms Greenway.

faqs.question: What do participants receive?
faqs.answer: Shirts are guaranteed for registrations by February 12. The half marathon lists long sleeve tech shirts and finisher medals; the 5K lists long sleeve cotton blend shirts.

faqs.question: Are pets or strollers allowed?
faqs.answer: The Event Info page says no pets and no strollers.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: The RunSignup refund policy page states that refunds are not allowed for this race.
